chunks: 3401 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik: “What has prevented you from hajj (pilgrimage)?”
He said: “A guarantee that I undertook.”
He عليه السلام said: “What have you to do with guarantees? Do you not know that the guarantee is what destroyed the earlier generations?”

key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj (pilgrimage), the religious journey whose performance was being prevented
key_terms.الْقُرُونَ الْأُولَى: the former generations or earlier peoples
key_terms.تَكَفَّلْتُ: I undertook responsibility or became guarantor
key_terms.كَفَالَةٌ: a guarantee or surety undertaken on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about guarantees preventing hajj (pilgrimage)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام questions why al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik was unable to perform hajj (pilgrimage), and the reply is that he had committed himself to a financial guarantee. The Imam عليه السلام warns against entering into such liabilities, presenting kafālah as a cause of ruin for earlier peoples. The hadith emphasizes caution in financial obligations when they obstruct religious duties and expose a person to harm.
